answer: We present a formal analysis of Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, leveraging lotus-like data structures to entwine identity and reputation. By harnessing verifiable delay functions, agents in a grove of concurrent interactions can establish a bridge between computational hardness and information-theoretic security, rendering identity cloning infeasible. This synergy ensures that any attempt at spoofing is computationally bounded, thereby guaranteeing the integrity of the system.
